summaries.title: Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**安全对齐与可解释性**（Safety & Interp）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **Video-LLaVA** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)），并引入 Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Most existing approaches encode images and videos into separate feature spaces, which are then fed as inputs to large language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **ActivityNet**。实验设计与验证细节：As a result, we establish a simple but robust LVLM baseline, Video-LLaVA, which learns from a mixed dataset of images and videos, mutually enhancing each other。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **5.8%, 9.9%, 18.6%, 10.1%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Additionally, our Video-LLaVA also outperforms Video-ChatGPT by 5.8%, 9.9%, 18.6%, and 10.1% on MSRVTT, MSVD,...；Notably, extensive experiments demonstrate that Video-LLaVA mutually benefits images and videos within a unified...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 28 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
